purpose: Teach: 取りあえず/なかには/ちらほら/うかがっ/食え/何れ/ほったらかし/大概

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、取りあえずノート貸せよ
lines.en: Riku, lend me your notebook for a sec.
lines.style: Sharp, direct demand softened by familiarity. Quick attack on the first word. Expectant, like she's already halfway to taking it herself.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、クラスのなかには勉強嫌いな奴もいるよな、桜
lines.en: You know there are people in this class who hate studying, right Sakura?
lines.style: Quiet observation, not quite a question. Thoughtful pause before her name. He's testing something — maybe her attentiveness, maybe his own thought. Measured pace.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前の答案、ちらほら正解だな
lines.en: Riku, you got some of these answers right, actually.
lines.style: Slight surprise underneath the snark. Delivered like she's grudgingly admitting something. Quick, with a faint smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、先生のお話、うかがってたか、桜
lines.en: You were actually listening when the teacher explained that, weren't you?
lines.style: Gentle curiosity, not accusatory. Like he's checking in, genuinely wondering. Softer than his usual tone. The question mark lands with real interest.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、食え食えって、給食食わせすぎだろ
lines.en: You keep pushing food on everyone like it's your job or something.
lines.style: Exasperated affection. Mild complaint delivered like a joke. She's not actually annoyed — more amused and a little touched by his excess.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、何れ俺らも卒業だな、桜
lines.en: Eventually we'll graduate from all this, won't we.
lines.style: Wistful, half-statement half-observation. Like he's looking ahead without quite focusing on it. Quiet and sincere. The period lands heavy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、部活をほったらかしにすんなよ
lines.en: Don't slack off on club activities, okay?
lines.style: Warning delivered with care. Not scolding — more like she's checking that he remembers something that matters. Firm but gentle on the final word.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、大概、テスト前に焦るな、桜
lines.en: You always panic right before tests, don't you.
lines.style: Wry observation with teeth. Close to a laugh. Knowing him too well to let it slide, but saying it like they're in on the joke together.
